Name: DaisyNiko's Portraits
Author: DaisyNiko
Description:
I'm going to try to do all characters eventually and update the files here, but so far it's just the female marriage candidates~

[b]To install:[/b]
[b]
[/b][list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[*]Download .rar file
[*]Unzip '[CP] Niko's Portraits' into [code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]

[/list]

[b]Configure options:[/b]

[list]
[*]Abigail wearing bow: "true", "false" (defaults to true)
[*]Maru's nurse outfit: "scrubs", "vanilla" (defaults to scrubs)
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Abigail, Emily, Haley, Leah, Maru, and Penny
